zangetsu.level.up.subtitle.2: The sword parries blows and severs limbs
zangetsu.level.up.subtitle.3: The sword now strikes evil mobs on its own
zangetsu.level.up.subtitle.5: Final Hollow Form: horned mask, stronger Getsuga
zangetsu.bond.angry: Zangetsu's eye has turned away from you. It will not open or help until you make amends — slay evil mobs.
zangetsu.bond.forgiven: Zangetsu's eye looks at you again.
zangetsu.cut.right_knee: Right knee cut — it cannot escape!
zangetsu.calling.line2: I watched you survive in this world. Build. Get up again.
zangetsu.calling.line3: You are worthy of carrying this sword.
zangetsu.calling.line4: Take it, and wake with it.
zangetsu.calling.warn: That is your bed. Lie down in it, and the sword is gone forever.
zangetsu.calling.refuse1: You turned away from what I held out to you.
zangetsu.calling.refuse3: From now until the end of time, your potential is lost.
zangetsu.calling.woke: You wake up. The sword will never come again.
zangetsu.calling.hint.take: Walk up and take the hilt: right-click the sword
zangetsu.calling.hint.refuse: Or go back to your bed behind you: right-click it, and you refuse forever
zangetsu.break.line: I am disappointed. I thought you were stronger.
zangetsu.break.woke: Zangetsu is broken. Go to sleep: it is waiting for you in a dream.
zangetsu.trial.line1: You were weak. That is why I took Zangetsu from you.
zangetsu.trial.line3: Find your true sword among a hundred fakes.
zangetsu.trial.line4: The true one has its eye on the inner side of the blade: face the eye, and the edge is on your right.
zangetsu.trial.line5: The fakes have it on the outside: the edge is on your left.
zangetsu.trial.wink: It is calling you. Look for the one that winks.
zangetsu.trial.found: It has forgiven you. Wake up.
zangetsu.trial.hint.take: Find the true Zangetsu: right-click the sword
zangetsu.trial.hint.refuse: Its eye is on the inner side: face the eye, and the edge is on your right
zangetsu.refused: The sword no longer recognizes you
zangetsu.bonded.title: ZANGETSU
zangetsu.bonded.subtitle: The sword has chosen you
zangetsu.bonded.guide: Zangetsu has an eye, and you must befriend it: slay evil mobs and spare the good ones. At night and in the dark the eye opens — and the sword fights on its own. Hover over the sword to see its level and bond.
zangetsu.hollow.locked: Hollow Form unlocks at level IV
zangetsu.hollow.refused: The eye is angry and refuses the Hollow's power
zangetsu.hollow.exhausted: The Hollow's power is spent: kill monsters or wait for the next day
zangetsu.hollow.broken: The mask is broken: no form for a whole day
zangetsu.hollow.crack.2: A piece of the mask has chipped off!
zangetsu.hollow.crack.3: The mask is about to shatter!
zangetsu.hollow.time_up: The mask shatters. You are exhausted.
zangetsu.no_drop: Zangetsu cannot be thrown away — it is bound to you
zangetsu.not_yours: This Zangetsu does not recognize you
zangetsu.lost: You have lost Zangetsu... Go to sleep — it will find you in a dream.
zangetsu.dream.title: A Dream
zangetsu.dream.subtitle: Hundreds of swords... Take any
zangetsu.dream.back.subtitle: It was always with you
zangetsu.tooltip.angry: The eye is angry: you killed good mobs
zangetsu.tooltip.ability.3: Strikes the nearest evil mobs on its own
zangetsu.tooltip.ability.4: Hollow Form: refills daily and with every kill, Getsuga Tensho
zangetsu.tooltip.ability.5: Final Form: horned mask, more strength and speed, bigger Getsuga
zangetsu.tooltip.hint: Abilities work while the eye is open: at night or in the dark
zangetsu.command.already_bonded: The sword is already yours. Run /zangetsu reset first
zangetsu.command.not_bonded: You don't have Zangetsu yet (/zangetsu give)
